correctness.rationale: Explicit path enumeration restricts X^m to the three coordinates of J^m. A linear functional in second-superdiagonal variables has either q^(m-1) or q^m solutions; the critical zero-support configurations are classified by exactly one internal zero or exactly two adjacent zeros. The resulting formulas satisfy the total-count identity, and direct independent matrix enumeration has passed for listed finite-field cases. The strict ordering of fibers follows from the binomial theorem; the group interpretation follows only for characteristic-power exponents.

originality.rationale: A directly checked earlier N_5 cubic-power formula is exactly the m=3 special case and is credited. The present theorem proves every exponent m>=2 simultaneously and an asymptotic conditional central-concentration law unavailable from a single small-dimension case. Primary texts of Bier, Sosnovsky, and Dolfi–Singh–Yadav discuss surjectivity, word width, and power images, not the stated root-count multiset. The earliest archival anchor was publicly posted in 2012. Genuine historical-priority uncertainty remains.

value.rationale: This is a complete characteristic-independent exact fiber distribution for the natural infinite family of niltriangular algebras at near-top power depth, including the first and last surjective power-word boundary for characteristic-power exponents. The formula detects target-dependent root multiplicities beyond image membership and proves a new conditional concentration rate, which cannot follow from the previously isolated cubic case or the published power-image existence theorems.
